name: Enlatics_benchmarking
description:
GAIA-style Evaluation Results (Public)
	

This dataset contains GAIA-inspired benchmark question results for LLM evaluation.

	
		
		What is inside
	


grok_answers.csv: question-by-question outputs, model used, response time (seconds), and run status.


	
		
		Notes
	


These tasks are designed in a GAIA-style (multi-hop, web-grounded questions).
Official GAIA leaderboard submission access was restricted for our account, so results are published here for transparency and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/enlatics/Enlatics_benchmarking.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented public release aimed at transparency; limited broader community adoption.
